audit.why: Soraka has zero mobility and no hard peel, so the hook threat controls every stage; her value is sustain, not lane presence, and she stays a priority pick target even after items.

Level 2 (Q + Riptide before heals matter), level 6 (Wish is a heal, not an escape, so Depth Charge still forces Flash or a kill), and first item (Q-E all-in outpaces single-target healing) are the real spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Equinox as matchup-defining but carries no cooldown digit; missingInteractions flags Soraka's anti-heal timing (Astral Infusion, Wish) as unaddressed.
audit.why: A real cooldown number turns the sequencing advice into something actionable, and Grievous Wounds timing against a double-heal kit is a checkable, high-value fact the page currently omits entirely.
audit.corrected: Added Equinox's real cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns and folded the anti-heal timing into the itemization report entry.
